conviction_note: Q3 numbers are new (no trading update, no MAR price-sensitive release since the H1 report). The one sourced lean is Italian diesel: monthly averages were +20.6%, +28.2% and +37.3% y/y in Jul/Aug/Sep 2026, against roughly +26% in Q2, the quarter in which MARR's EBITDA fell from 37.7m to 31.7m and which the company itself blamed on fuel and energy. October was +38.8% and November so far +33.6%, which weighs on the H2 commentary. Against that, the stock is already down 20% since the H1 print, the short is small and flat (1.31%), July tourism presences rose 4.4%, and the bar is a single broker's qualitative 'H2 EBITDA slightly above H2 2025'. The release usually lands in the afternoon session (15:37 and 16:13 CEST on the last two prints), so the window only holds about 1.5 to 2 hours of the reaction. The result is abs_move 5.0 and p_up 40, giving -1.0 scaled; the findings sum to -1.1 on their own.

findings.finding: Italian diesel averaged about 2.115 EUR/l in Q3 2026, roughly +29% y/y (Jul +20.6%, Aug +28.2%, Sep +37.3%), against about +26% in Q2 2026. Q2 is the quarter in which MARR's EBITDA fell 16% and the company blamed fuel and energy. October (+38.8%) and November (+33.6%) are higher still, so Q3 transport costs are at least as heavy as Q2's and the H2 commentary inherits them. That points to Q3 EBITDA below the 42.6m of Q3 2025 and below Intesa's 'H2 slightly up' bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Every 2026 print missed on margin and fell. FY25 (13 Mar 2026): -5.0% on the day, -16.9% the next. Q1 (15 May): -3.1%, then -6.2% (about -0.5% after the 0.47 ex-dividend). H1 (4 Aug): +0.9%, then -1.5%. Q3 2025 (Nov 2025): -1.0%, then -4.0%. Closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/MARR.MI?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.original_quote: 2026 Settembre 2,2411 6,84% 37,27% | 2026 Agosto 2,0977 4,59% 28,23% | 2026 Luglio 2,0057 1,79% 20,64% | 2026 Ottobre 2,2513 0,45% 38,84%. Transmission stated by the company in its H1 report: 'il miglioramento del primo margine, che solo in parte ha mitigato gli incrementi dei costi di trasporto e dei costi di conservazione dei prodotti, dovuti rispettivamente all'aumento del costo del carburante e dei costi energetici' (H1 report, https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-08/20260804_187867.pdf). Translation: the better first margin only partly offset higher transport and storage costs, caused respectively by higher fuel and energy costs.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is down from 6.49 to about 5.2 since H1 (-20%) with no company news, which fits the market pricing a cost squeeze. But the only visible broker bar (Intesa, 5 Aug) still has H2 EBITDA slightly UP y/y, and that was set when August diesel was +28% and before September (+37%) and October (+39%) printed. With six analysts, no visible note since August and nothing on the quarter, nobody has publicly mapped the fuel series onto Q3. If it were fully priced there would be a pre-print cut or a Q3 preview, and there is neither.
findings.independence: The H1 report's own attribution (company document, different source) and Intesa's 5 Aug note on energy costs (https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/08/05/marr-intesa-sanpaolo-lima-il-prezzo-obiettivo-e-ribadisce-il-neutral-145.html) both point the same way. Neither measures Q3 itself.

baseline_tension: The lean cuts against the priced lean (+0.76, almost all of it the small-short squeeze term) and against a flat 20-day run-up (+0.58%). It agrees with the 60-day slide (-18.7%), which means part of it is already in the price.
language_note: The issuer's corporate calendar (Italian page) gave the 13/11/2026 board date for the 'resoconto intermedio di gestione del terzo trimestre 2026'.
The Teleborsa Italian wire timestamps (15:37 and 16:13 CEST) were the only evidence that MARR releases in the afternoon session; that settled the session question.

The H1 report's Italian text carried the company's own fuel and energy attribution and the July trading comment; the Italian diesel series (rivaluta, MIMIT-based) is the independent series behind the main finding.
Intesa's H2 EBITDA view and the Equita/Intesa reactions to Q1 came only through Italian Teleborsa copy; no English source added anything.
lessons_applied: 'Two findings resting on one document are one finding': the Q3 diesel finding (-1.2) and the Oct/Nov diesel outlook finding (-0.6) came from one series, so they were merged into one finding at -1.5 rather than summed to -1.8.

'Too small about the move; size on what is new': the Q3 numbers are not pre-released, so abs_move_pct went from 4.5 to 5.0. It was held below the 7% base because the release is in session and the window carries only about 1.5 to 2 hours of it.
'Reaction history moves p_up, not abs_move': MARR sold every 2026 print, which moved p_up from 42 to 40.
'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company says it': the company did say it (H1 report), so the diesel finding stays filed; it is held small because the bar is unsourced.
